title: Preregistration
description: DESIGN-stage artifact (audit C3). Freezes the analysis contract BEFORE results exist: primary metric, condition set, planned seeds, stopping rule, analysis plan. Checkpointed into the hash-chained ledger so it cannot be quietly rewritten after the numbers arrive; tools/prereg.check_deviation mechanically compares the ANALYZE-stage result_summary against it (outcome switching / undeclared conditions BLOCK).

primary_metric.description: THE preregistered primary outcome metric — its absence from the findings is a deviation violation

secondary_metrics.description: Other metrics the analysis may report as findings; anything outside primary+secondary in findings is outcome switching

condition_ids.description: The preregistered condition set (sorted); a finding on an undeclared condition is a deviation violation

hypotheses.description: The hypotheses (from the experiment_matrix ranked_batch) this design commits to test

n_seeds_planned.description: Planned distinct seeds per condition; fewer at ANALYZE is a visible warning (honest partial progress), never silent

stopping_rule.description: When data collection stops (fixed N seeds / fixed budget) — frozen up front so results cannot decide when to stop

analysis_plan.description: The committed analysis (e.g. 'paired permutation test vs baseline on the primary metric, Holm-corrected across findings, alpha=0.05')
